model_contract.individual_only: Each factor-side model receives only features with a direct basketball connection to that outcome.
model_contract.teammate_context: The candidate adds leave-one-player-out, possession-weighted same-team context fields. It never includes the focal player's own value in a teammate aggregate.
model_contract.direct_normal_baseline: A separate ridge predicts normal offense and defense RAPM from the union of the individual factor features.
model_contract.factor_merge: Separate offense and defense ridge maps convert the three predicted factor ratings into normal points RAPM. Net equals offense plus defense.
model_contract.sample_weight: Square root of the applicable factor exposure for factor targets and square root of minimum-side possessions for normal RAPM.

selection_rule: Choose alpha separately for each target-side and candidate using 2024 fits scored on 2025 weighted factor-target RMSE. Choose direct-normal alpha by 2025 side RMSE. Freeze all choices before reused 2026 diagnostics.
primary_comparison: 2026 normal RAPM weighted RMSE and correlation for individual factor decomposition, teammate-context factor decomposition, direct related-feature SPM, oracle factor reconstruction, and mean baseline.
secondary_comparison: 2026 weighted RMSE, correlation, and R-squared against each of the six factor RAPM targets.
stopping_rules: Do not modify features or alphas after inspecting 2026.
Do not promote teammate context as player skill. It is a descriptive context ablation.
Do not call the three-factor merge an exact additive decomposition because free throws, shot volume, and other residual scoring channels remain in normal RAPM.
